metadata.notes:
Thomas DAC pattern (aka Cnp) at 3ms point delay and 3ms cycle delay. Uses 4.08V as the 5V equivalent - to compensate for the voltage drop across the optocoupler (MOC3010) in the real-world signal path.

Original DAC points provided by Dr. Persinger circa 2008.

First described as the 'Cnp' in:

Thomas AW, Kavaliers M, Prato FS, Ossenkopp KP. Analgesic effects of a specific pulsed magnetic field in the land snail, Cepaea nemoralis: consequences of repeated exposures, relations to tolerance and cross-tolerance with DPDPE. Peptides. 1998;19(2):333-42. doi: 10.1016/s0196-9781(97)00380-x. PMID: 9493866.
